admin_email_verifications_recipient_cons.name: admin_email_verifications_recipient_consistency
admin_email_verifications_recipient_cons.value:
(
        "admin_email_verifications"."recipient_type" = 'login_email'
        AND "admin_email_verifications"."admin_email_id" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "admin_email_verifications"."recipient_type" = 'backup_email'
        AND "admin_email_verifications"."admin_email_id" IS NULL
      )

admin_emails_verification_timestamp_cons.name: admin_emails_verification_timestamp_consistency
admin_emails_verification_timestamp_cons.value:
("admin_emails"."is_verified" = true AND "admin_emails"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("admin_emails"."is_verified" = false AND "admin_emails"."verified_at" IS NULL)

admin_security_settings_backup_verificat.name: admin_security_settings_backup_verification_consistency
admin_security_settings_backup_verificat.value:
"admin_security_settings"."backup_email_encrypted" IS NOT NULL
          OR "admin_security_settings"."backup_email_verified_at" IS NULL

admin_sessions_revocation_consistency.name: admin_sessions_revocation_consistency
admin_sessions_revocation_consistency.value:
("admin_sessions"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "admin_sessions"."revocation_reason" IS NULL)
          OR ("admin_sessions"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)
